title: Basic Motions
description: Move without the arrow keys: h j k l, word motions, line edges, and file edges.

levels.title: Baby steps
levels.description: Put the cursor on the 'q' of 'question'. Arrow keys are for tourists: use j and l.
levels.hint: j moves down a line, l moves right a character.

levels.title: Skip the small talk
levels.description: Jump straight to the word 'server'. Pressing l twenty-seven times is allowed, but it will be remembered.
start_text: hi hello hey greetings the server is on fire
levels.hint: w jumps to the start of the next word.

levels.title: Back pedal
levels.description: You said too much. Back up to the start of 'robot' before anyone notices.
start_text: I am absolutely not a robot beep boop
levels.hint: b jumps back to the start of the previous word.

levels.title: The end is nigh
levels.description: Land on the last letter of 'friday', where all good deploys end.
levels.hint: e jumps to the end of the current or next word.

levels.title: Living on the edge
levels.description: Get to the very last character of the return line. The mood will not improve on the way.
levels.hint: $ jumps to the end of the line.

levels.title: Back to the top
levels.description: Read the script from the beginning: put the cursor on the '#' at the top.
levels.hint: gg jumps to the first line (G to the last). ^ jumps to the first non-blank character.
